auto-close-tag.activationOnLanguage.description: Set the languages that the extension will be activated.  e.g. ["html","xml","php"]. Use ["*"] to activate for all languages.

auto-close-tag.disableOnLanguage.description: Set the languages where the extension will be disabled.  e.g. ["html","xml","php"].

auto-close-tag.excludedTags.description: Set the tag list that would not be auto closed.

auto-close-tag.SublimeText3Mode.description: Auto close tag when </ is typed, same as Sublime Text 3

auto-close-tag.enableAutoCloseTag.description: Whether to insert close tag automatically

auto-close-tag.enableAutoCloseSelfClosin.description: Whether to close self-closing tag automatically

auto-close-tag.insertSpaceBeforeSelfClos.description: Insert a space before the forward slash in a self-closing tag.

auto-close-tag.fullMode.description: Enable both Visual Studio and Sublime Text mode

auto-rename-tag.activationOnLanguage.description: Set the languages that the extension will be activated.  e.g. ["html","xml","php"] By default, it is ["*"] and will be activated for all languages.

errorLens.enabled.description: Controls all decorations and features (except commands).

errorLens.respectUpstreamEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - extension will take into account global VSCode setting `#problems.visibility#`. ([1.85.0 changelog](https://code.visualstudio.com/updates/v1_85#_hide-problem-decorations)).

errorLens.enabledInMergeConflict.markdownDescription: Controls if decorations are shown if the editor has git merge conflict indicators `<<<<<<<` or `=======` or `>>>>>>>`.

errorLens.fontWeight.markdownDescription: Font weight of inline message. `"normal"` is alias for 400, `"bold"` is alias for 700).

errorLens.fontStyleItalic.description: When enabled - shows inline message in italic font style.

errorLens.margin.markdownDescription: Distance between the last word on the line and the start of inline message ([CSS units](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/length)).

start.description: Starting column where to align decorations.

end.description: Ending column where to align decorations.

minimumMargin.description: Minimal space between line end and decoration. Very similar to the global setting `errorLens.margin`, but can only be a number of characters.

useFixedPosition.description: Use fixed position for decoration that has stuttering/twitching when typing... BUT!!! decoration can overlap text in editor for a short period of time on the active line.

errorLens.alignMessage.markdownDescription: Align inline error message (either by starting position or ending position). Set "start" and "end" to **0** to disable.

errorLens.padding.markdownDescription: Padding of the inline message. Visible when `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` is set to "message".

errorLens.borderRadius.markdownDescription: Border radius of the inline message. Visible when `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` is set to "message".

errorLens.enabledDiagnosticLevels.description: Customize which diagnostic levels(severity) to highlight.

errorLens.messageTemplate.markdownDescription:
Template used for all inline messages. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

- `$source` - Source of diagnostic e.g. "eslint"

- `$code` - Code of the diagnostic

errorLens.messageMaxChars.markdownDescription: Cut off inline message if it's longer than this value. (Improves performance when the diagnostic message is long).

errorLens.messageEnabled.description: Controls whether inline message is shown or not (Including background highlight).

enumDescriptions: The entire line is highlighted.
Inline message is highlighted.
Message is not highlighted (only has foreground colors).
errorLens.messageBackgroundMode.description: Controls how inline message is highlighted in the editor (entire line / only message / none).

errorLens.problemRangeDecorationEnabled.markdownDescription: When checked - highlight the entire problem range.

errorLens.editorHoverPartsEnabled.markdownDescription: Controls which parts of the editor hover tooltip to show.

errorLens.statusBarIconsEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - shows highlighted error/warning icons in status bar.

errorLens.statusBarIconsPriority.markdownDescription: Move status bar icons left or right by adjusting the number priority.

errorLens.statusBarIconsAlignment.markdownDescription: Choose on which side the icons status bar is on: left or right.

enumDescriptions: Should be the same as native status bar icons - counts all known problems from all files.
Count only problems from the active text editor.
Count only problems from the visible text editors.
errorLens.statusBarIconsTargetProblems.markdownDescription: Which problems to use for counting problems at icons status bar.

errorLens.statusBarIconsUseBackground.markdownDescription: When enabled - highlights status bar icons with background, when disabled - with foreground.

errorLens.statusBarIconsAtZero.markdownDescription: What to do when there are 0 errors/warnings - hide the item or strip its background color.

errorLens.statusBarMessageEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - shows message in status bar.

errorLens.statusBarMessagePriority.markdownDescription: Move status bar message left or right by adjusting the number priority.

errorLens.statusBarMessageAlignment.markdownDescription: Choose on which side the message status bar is on: left or right.

errorLens.statusBarColorsEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - use message decoration foreground as color of Status Bar text.

errorLens.statusBarMessageType.markdownDescription: Pick what to show in Status Bar: closest message or only message for the active line.
enumDescriptions: Show closest to the cursor diagnostic.
Show closest to the cursor diagnostic (sorted by severity e.g. error will be shown before warning even if it's farther from the cursor).
Show only diagnostic that is on the same line as the cursor.
Similar to "activeLine" but follows the cursor movement inside the line.

errorLens.statusBarCommand.markdownDescription: Pick command that activates on click for Status Bar.

errorLens.statusBarMessageTemplate.markdownDescription:
Template for status bar message. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

- `$source` - Source of diagnostic e.g. "eslint"

- `$code` - Code of the diagnostic

matcher.description: The RegExp pattern against which to match diagnostic messages

message.description: The entire replacement for messages matching matcher. Can reference match groups like $0 (entire expression), $1 (first capture group), etc.

errorLens.replace.markdownDescription: Specify message to transform. E.g. if this is configured to [{ matcher: 'foo (.*)', message: 'just $1' }], the message 'foo bar' would be displayed as 'just bar'.

errorLens.exclude.markdownDescription: Specify messages that should not be highlighted (RegExp). Strings passed to the RegExp constructor: `new RegExp(EXCLUDE_ITEM, 'i');`

errorLens.excludeBySource.markdownDescription:
Specify `source` or `source(code)` pair to exclude. Examples: 

```json
[
	"eslint",// exclude all problems from eslint linter
	"eslint(padded-blocks)",// exclude padded-blocks rule from eslint linter
	"Pylance(reportUndefinedVariable)",// exlude reportUndefinedVariable rule from Pylance linter
]
```

errorLens.excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Exclude files by using [glob](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) pattern. Example `["**/*.{ts,js}"]`

errorLens.disableLineComments.markdownDescription:
Used for `errorLens.disableLine` command that adds a comment disabling linter rule for a line.
To force comment on the same line - add `SAME_LINE` to the message: `"eslint": "// eslint-disable-line $code SAME_LINE"`

errorLens.lintFilePaths.markdownDescription: Specify where to search for linter rule definitions by diagnostic source ([glob](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) for local linter files). `node_modules` folder is excluded.

errorLens.searchForProblemQuery.markdownDescription: Pick query to open in default browser when searching for problem with `errorLens.searchForProblem` command.

enumDescriptions: Show closest to the cursor diagnostic.
Show closest to the cursor diagnostic (sorted by severity e.g. error will be shown before warning even if it's farther from the cursor).
Show only diagnostic that is on the same line as the cursor.
errorLens.selectProblemType.markdownDescription: Which problem to select (closest / active line) when executing `errorLens.selectProblem` command.

errorLens.light.markdownDescription: Specify color of decorations for when the light color theme is active.

errorGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to error gutter icon for light themes.

warningGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to warning gutter icon for light themes.

infoGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to info gutter icon for light themes.

hintGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to hint gutter icon for light themes.

errorGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Error color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

warningGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Warning color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

infoGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Info color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

hintGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Hint color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters) for light themes.

errorLens.delay.markdownDescription: Delay (ms) before showing problem decorations (**0** to disable). Minimum delay of **500** is enforced by the extension. `#errorLens.delayMode#` controls how to handle the delay.

markdownEnumDescriptions: New problems appear according to `errorLens.delay` setting. Fixed problems disappear faster. A bit buggy.
Decorations for problems are debounced according to `errorLens.delay` setting.
errorLens.delayMode.markdownDescription: Pick which version of the delay to use.

errorLens.onSave.description: When enabled - updates decorations only on document save (manual).

errorLens.onSaveTimeout.description: Time period (ms) that used for showing decorations after the document save (manual, not auto save).

errorLens.onSaveUpdateOnActiveEditorChan.description: When `#errorLens.onSave#` enabled - extension still draws decorations when active/visible editors change.

errorLens.enableOnDiffView.markdownDescription: Enable decorations when viewing a diff view in the editor (e.g. Git diff).

enumDescriptions: Highlight all problems in file
Highlight all problems in file (except the line at the cursor)
Highlight only the problem at the cursor
Highlight only closest to the cursor problem
Highlight only closest to the cursor problem (only in visible lines) (decoration spans multiple lines)
Highlight only closest to the cursor problem (error before warning, ...) (decoration spans multiple lines)
errorLens.followCursor.description: Highlight only portion of the problems.

errorLens.followCursorMore.markdownDescription:
Augments `#errorLens.followCursor#`.
Adds number of lines to top and bottom when `#errorLens.followCursor#` is set to `activeLine`.
 Adds number of closest problems when `#errorLens.followCursor#` is `closestProblem`

useFixedPosition.description: Use fixed position for decoration that has stuttering/twitching when typing... BUT!!! decoration can overlap text in editor for a short period of time on the active line.

errorLens.gutterIconsEnabled.description: When enabled - shows gutter icons (In place of the debug breakpoint icon).

errorLens.gutterIconsFollowCursorOverrid.markdownDescription: When enabled and `#errorLens.followCursor#` setting is not `allLines`, then gutter icons would be rendered for all problems. But line decorations (background, message) only for active line.

enumDescriptions: Similar to vscode icons in Problems Panel (old).
Similar to vscode icons in Problems Panel (new).
Similar to vscode icons in Problems Panel, only without a border.
Simple filled circle.
Simple filled square.
Simple filled square with rounded corners.
Simple one letter icon (E,W,I,H).
Emoji. (`errorLens.gutterEmoji` to control which emoji to show.)

errorLens.gutterEmoji.markdownDescription: Pick emoji symbol for gutter icon when `#errorLens.gutterIconSet#` is `emoji`.

errorLens.errorGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to error gutter icon.

errorLens.warningGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to warning gutter icon.

errorLens.infoGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to info gutter icon.

errorLens.hintGutterIconPath.description: Absolute path to hint gutter icon.

errorLens.errorGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Error color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters).

errorLens.warningGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Warning color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters).

errorLens.infoGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Info color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters).

errorLens.hintGutterIconColor.markdownDescription: Hint color of simple gutter icons (shapes and letters).

errorLens.removeLinebreaks.markdownDescription: When enabled - replaces line breaks in inline diagnostic message with whitespaces.

errorLens.replaceLinebreaksSymbol.markdownDescription: Symbol to replace linebreaks. Requires enabling `#errorLens.removeLinebreaks#`.

errorLens.scrollbarHackEnabled.markdownDescription: When enabled - prevents showing horizontal scrollbar in editor (caused by inline decorations). Also prevents mouse hover at inline message.

errorLens.decorations.markdownDescription:
Advanced decoration tweaking. Possible keys: `errorRange`, `warningRange`, `infoRange`, `hintRange`.

 Possible properties: `backgroundColor`, `color`, `outline`, `border`, ...,

errorLens.ignoreUntitled.description: Controls whether to run on untitled (unsaved) files.

errorLens.codeLensEnabled.markdownDescription: Controls whether to show the Error Lens as a Code Lens above the code.

errorLens.codeLensLength.markdownDescription: Enforce minimum length of the first code lens item and max length of subsequent items.

errorLens.codeLensTemplate.markdownDescription:
Template used for all messages appearing in the `#errorLens.codeLensEnabled#`. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

- `$source` - Source of diagnostic e.g. "eslint"

- `$code` - Code of the diagnostic

filesize.useDecimal.description: Defaults to false, using IEC's representation. Set to true to get SI representation.

filesize.use24HourFormat.description: Defaults to true, using 24-hour format. Set to false to get 12-hour format.

filesize.showGzip.description: Defaults to true, whether to show gzip size in detailed view or not.

filesize.showBrotli.description: Defaults to false, whether to show brotli size in the detailed view.

filesize.showRawInBytes.description: Defaults to false, whether to show raw size in bytes in the detailed view.

filesize.showGzipInStatusBar.description: Defaults to false, whether to show gzip size in the status bar.

filesize.showBrotliInStatusBar.description: Defaults to false, whether to show brotli size in the status bar.

filesize.displayInfoOnTheRightSideOfStat.description: Defaults to false, whether to show the filesize info on the right side of the status bar.

indentRainbow.includedLanguages.description: For which languages indent-rainbow should be activated. When empty will use for all languages.

indentRainbow.excludedLanguages.description: For which languages indent-rainbow should be deactivated. When left empty will ignore.

indentRainbow.ignoreErrorLanguages.description: For which languages indent-rainbow should skip indent error detection (use '*' to deactivate errors for all languages).

indentRainbow.updateDelay.description: The delay in ms until the editor gets updated.

indentRainbow.errorColor.description: Indent color for when there is an error in the indentation, for example if you have your tabs set to 2 spaces but the indent is 3 spaces. Can be any type of web based color format (hex, rgba, rgb).

indentRainbow.tabmixColor.description: Indent color for when there is a mix between spaces and tabs in the indentation. Can be any type of web based color format (hex, rgba, rgb) or a empty string(to be disabled this coloring).

indentRainbow.ignoreLinePatterns.description: Skip error highlighting for RegEx patterns. Defaults to c/cpp decorated block and full line comments.

indentRainbow.colors.description: An array with color (hex, rgba, rgb) strings which are used as colors, can be any length.

indentRainbow.colorOnWhiteSpaceOnly.description: If error color is disabled, indent colors will be rendered until the length of rendered characters (white spaces, tabs, and other ones) is divisible by tabsize. Turn on this option to render white spaces and tabs only.

indentRainbow.indicatorStyle.markdownDescription: Classic mode uses a full colored tab to indicate the indendation. Light mode will only display a colored border similar to the default indent guide lines. You can disable the default indicators with `#editor.guides.indentation#`.

indentRainbow.lightIndicatorStyleLineWid.description: This property defines the indent indicator lineWidth when using light mode.

pomodoroClock.longBreakTime.description: Time of long break, in minutes

pomodoroClock.repeat.description: Number of repeat before long break

todohighlight.isCaseSensitive.description: Specify whether the keywords are case sensitive or not

todohighlight.toggleURI.description: If the file path within the output channel not clickable, set this to true to toggle the path patten between `<path>#<line>` and `<path>:<line>:<column>`

todohighlight.keywords.description: Customize keywords and colors. Any css color identifier is valid.

color.description: The text color. Besides, you can play with all the string and boolean styling properties provied by VS Code API. See all available properties on VSCode doc DecorationRenderOptions section: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions

backgroundColor.description: The text background color. See all available properties on VSCode doc DecorationRenderOptions section: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions

overviewRulerColor.description: The color of the ruler mark on the scroll bar. Use rgba() and define transparent colors to play well with other decorations. See all available properties on VSCode doc DecorationRenderOptions section: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions

todohighlight.keywordsPattern.description: Specify keywords via RegExp instead of `todohighlight.keywords` one by one. NOTE that if this presents, `todohighlight.keywords` will be ignored. And REMEMBER to escapse the back slash if there's any in your regexp (using \\ instead of single back slash)

todohighlight.defaultStyle.description: Default style for all customized keywords

color.description: The text color. See all available properties on VSCode doc DecorationRenderOptions section: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions

backgroundColor.description: The text background color. See all available properties on VSCode doc DecorationRenderOptions section: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions

overviewRulerColor.description: The color of the ruler mark on the scroll bar. See all available properties on VSCode doc DecorationRenderOptions section: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions

todohighlight.include.description: Glob patterns that defines the files to search for. Only include files you need, DO NOT USE `{**/*.*}` for both permormance and avoiding binary files reason.

anyOf.description: A glob pattern that defines the files to search for. Only include files you need, DO NOT USE `**/*.*` for both performance and avoiding binary files reason

todohighlight.exclude.description: Glob pattern that defines files and folders to exclude while listing annotations.

anyOf.description: A glob pattern that defines files and folders to exclude while listing annotations

themeswitch.priority.description: The priority for the statusbar toggle

themeswitch.toggleDefaultDark.description: If your preferred light/dark theme is not the current theme and the toggle is triggered, switch to your dark theme
